name: io.github.SaqibNaseer404/wiselyarcade
title: Wisely Arcade Games
description: List, search and recommend 35 free learning games by age and skill, as MCP tools for AI agents.

tools.name: list_games
tools.description: List Wisely Arcade games, optionally filtered by age band (kids = ages 5-9, teens = 10-17, adults = 18+) and/or skill slug (memory, logic, maths, words, racing, strategy, knowledge).

tools.name: get_game
tools.description: Get full details for one Wisely Arcade game by its slug (for example "chess" or "letter-garden").

slug.description: The game slug, as used in its URL.

tools.name: search_games
tools.description: Search Wisely Arcade games by keyword — matches titles, descriptions, lessons and skills.

query.description: Keyword or phrase to search for.

tools.name: recommend_games
tools.description: Recommend up to 5 Wisely Arcade games for a player of a given age, optionally focused on one skill. Recommendations start from the gentlest games.

tools.name: list_skills
tools.description: List the seven skill areas Wisely Arcade games practise, with game counts and hub links.

tools.name: about_wisely_arcade
tools.description: Plain facts about Wisely Arcade: what it is, safety for children, how the 100-level climb works, and where the catalogue and parent guide live.
